_why: NIGHT40 builder B4 (design.n40.loom40 swaps n38-span for this file): Tools/night/gen-n40-span.cjs, a copy of gen-n38-span.cjs without the STITCHER. NIGHT38 builder O2 (design.n38.span38 swaps n37-span for n38-span): from the beat sheet Design/levels/n38/span.beats.md. Five new rooms (p1 HOOK YARD, p2 FIRST GAP, p3 KNOT YARD, p4 PULL LINE, p5 SPOOL HALL), then NIGHT37's o1 THREAD LINE, o2 SWING ANCHOR and o3 THE CANYON (THE LOOM) copied as they are. Spacing from PortExport/config.json (ground.walkSpeed, jump.height, dash.speed x dash.duration, slide.colliderHeight) + Design/levels/n35-ride-distances.json (rideSpeed, jumpOff.pitch0, facingGapsThatWork) and design.n32.grapple32.

rooms.name: 4.9 SWING ANCHOR
rooms.verb36: pull to a moving anchor + hook a knee and pull away (the tear)
rooms.respawnY_why: a fall into the void is back at the room's start (Campaign24's respawnY, the share of health design.n29.roomRules.fallCostFraction): rehearsal, not punishment

loomSwing37._why: the anchor's swing: +- ampX m east-west about its rest, one period in periodS (design.n37.loom37.swingAmpM / swingPeriodS win when present)

kneeTarget37.why: the practice knee (loom40: a grapple node): hook it from the post, then pull away to the far thread (node 3): it tears (a cyan burst), back 3 s later

rooms.name: 4.10 THE CANYON
rooms.verb36: grapple crossing + nail and tear (the exam)
rooms.respawnY_why: the campaign's fallback only: with design.n37.loom37 on, Game/SurvivalSim.Loom37.cs catches a fall first (feet under design.n37.loom37.fallY) and puts the player on the last anchor ledge for -20 HP
rooms.grapple: THREAD ANCHORS (BOSSES.md L4): one pair before each tower pair and one pair over each tower top (the anchor ledges), one over the end ledge; THE LOOM's six knees join them as moving nodes for the fight (Game/SurvivalSim.Loom37.cs) and it cuts the ones behind it

loom37._why: THE CANYON's data for Game/SurvivalSim.Loom37.cs (builder O): anchors = the room's grappleNodes in order (id, pair, the ledge under it); ledges = the anchor ledges (a fall comes back to the last one stood on); stations = where THE LOOM hangs for each leg (leg 3 = the nest); webWalls = the sheet each leg can weave between a tower pair (a layer swap); all world metres

loom40NoRide._why: NIGHT40 B4 (D-12): the canyon's ride walls that refuse a ride while THE LOOM fights, by phase (Game/SurvivalSim.N40.Loom.cs switches the Mover's noride set at the fight's begin and at the leg change, after a 1 s warning). Liners 0.2 m thick on the faces, no collision. Phase 1 = leg 1: 5 of the 14 ride walls; phase 2 = legs 2-3: 10 of 14.
